items.title: File Einspruch against amended income tax assessment 2024
items.quote: Einzulegen ist er innerhalb eines Monats seit der Bekanntgabe – schriftlich, elektronisch oder mündlich zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter is dated Monday 29.12.2025 and presumably handed to the post on the same day. The letter itself states the current statutory Bekanntgabe-fiction for simple mail (since the 2025 amendment to §122 Abs. 2 AO: notice is deemed received on the 4th day after posting, unless it arrived later or not at all). Day of posting = 29.12.2025; counting the 4 days (30.12., 31.12., 01.01.2026, 02.01.2026) gives Bekanntgabe on 02.01.2026 (a Friday, not a Sunday/holiday, so the fiction applies as computed). Under §108 Abs. 1 AO i.V.m. §187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month Einspruchsfrist begins on the day after Bekanntgabe (03.01.2026). Under §188 Abs. 2 BGB the month-long period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day of the triggering event (the Bekanntgabe day, 2 January), i.e. 02.02.2026. That day is a Monday (not a Saturday, Sunday or NRW public holiday), so no further shift under §108 Abs. 3 AO/§193 BGB is needed. Deadline: 02.02.2026.
